A direct, front-facing photograph captured from CAMERA_ANGLE. The interior back wall is lined with CUPBOARD_LINING_MATERIAL, and the individual shelves are made of RACK_MATERIAL.

Directive 3: The Miniature Dioramas & Figures
The structure houses a cohesive miniature world divided across three shelves, adhering to the OVERALL_DIORAMA_THEME. Crucially, each shelf must contain miniature figures engaged in a specific narrative action.
* Top Shelf: Miniature figures are depicted [TOP_SHELF_SCENE].

* Bottom Shelf: Miniature figures are depicted [BOTTOM_SHELF_SCENE].

Directive 4: Atmosphere & Lighting

Clean grey studio background, soft gradient backdrop, professional corporate headshot style. Soft diffused key light, subtle rim lighting, sharp facial details, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, f/2, high dynamic range, crisp focus, cinematic color grading, 8K resolution, premium editorial photography.

prompts.title: 空灵数字绘画肖像

prompts.prompt: A highly detailed 4K digital painting of a young woman [Use the uploaded image as reference] with light eyes and wavy dark hair. She wears a high-neck white lace garment, with one hand gracefully positioned near her collarbone showing neutral manicured nails. The color palette is warm and earthy, dominated by browns, burnt sienna, and copper. Soft, diffused lighting creates a gentle glow on her face. The composition is a close-up portrait. The background is textured and mottled with faint vintage damask overlays that softly blend into the subject's edges. Ethereal, romantic, and subtly mysterious mood with a stylized painterly finish.
prompts.translatedPrompt: 一幅高度精细的 4K 数字绘画，描绘了一位年轻女性（请参考上传图片），她拥有浅色眼睛和波浪状的深色头发。她身穿高领白色蕾丝服装，一只手优雅地放在锁骨附近，展示着修剪整齐的自然色指甲。色彩调色板温暖而质朴，以棕色、赭色和铜色为主。柔和的漫射光线在她脸上营造出一种温和的光泽。构图是特写肖像。背景纹理斑驳，带有淡淡的复古大马士革图案叠加，柔和地融入主体边缘。整体氛围空灵、浪漫，并带有一丝神秘感，呈现出风格化的绘画效果。

prompts.title: 前卫风情花园时尚大片
